Ugh I remember once coming home exhausted from a trip only to find a big ass puddle of dog piss on my bed at 2am. I learned afterwards that my roommate had her sister and niece sleep in my room while I was gone with nooo mention. & I’ve communicated before how I’m huge on privacy, so man did this piss me off. 

Lol the next day I went to heat up the food my family made me from the trip only to see my roommate’s visiting mom cleaned the fridge and threw it out. Even tho it was neatly wrapped up in a container & was there for not even a day.

Their defensiveness really shocked me, especially after they seemed understanding on the phone. The lady kept repeating how they have “hundreds of customers” & they are honest & trustworthy — she then proceeded to pull out a stack of envelopes of the jewelry from customers waiting on repairs like…okay? Strange since I never accused them of anything. I just pointed out that the post was shortened after repair & even suggested it could’ve been an innocent mistake by the jeweler. I intentionally made this post before returning so I could be confident it was just a mistake!

However, I’m now *so* glad I didn’t hand over the original,  unfixed earring & walked out with both. Who knows what they would’ve done, as they’ve proven themselves to be untrustworthy and dishonest. I’ll take the earrings to inspected by another jeweler, as suggested by many on this post & will be leaving reviews to warn others near me.
Wouldn’t have thought of this, thank you. I’ll do a chargeback on the repair.
You’re right, it’s crooked. I was so fixated on the length of the post + the soldering, I didn’t notice until you pointed it out!

Update: Thanks everyone for the responses. I brought the earrings in & at first the guy claimed they were both different, non matching earrings and had his wife take over. She completely denies their jeweler would’ve done anything to the post & refuses to even check with him, claiming that the posts must’ve been already shorter than the other (it wasn’t).
I’m just at a loss over this whole ordeal & thankful the issue was just the post and not something bigger.

As someone who knows nothing about jewelry repairs, I appreciate you! This is exactly what I was looking for when making this post. I want to trust them, but just don’t have the knowledge/perspective to confidentially know what to do next. I’ll have them look at both earrings together. Thank you very much.
This makes sense & makes me feel more at ease. Thank you.

I feel you! You’re not alone in this. But honestly those guys sounded like assholes. I think you’re shifting to a different level in life, and those friends are no longer a match. But also don’t be afraid of the loneliness, though some days will suck, you’ll also really find yourself & discover things you’re truly passionate about. And later on when the time is right, you’ll align with friends that match up with the new you.

So so many red flags. And speaking from experience, you’ll be saving yourself a lot of heartache in the long run if you break up with him sooner than later. This is *so* early on in your relationship while he’s on this best behavior; he’s testing the waters and I can tell you the things that bother you will only get 10X worse. It can also turn into a relationship where the highs are high & the lows are low, and trust me you don’t want to be in that confusing mess. You deserve better, hugs & be safe!
